caption:
What a balance really costs. 💸
A $5,000 balance at 19.71% APR adds roughly $82 in interest in one month.
That's before any payment toward the actual balance.
Send this to someone who only pays the minimum.
first_comment: What would you do with an extra $82 a month? 👇
